{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).
"}

function escapeRegExp(s) {

function remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName) {
    if (!branchName || !isSafeRefName(branchName)) return false;
    var out = cleanCommandOutput(runCommand(workingDir, 'git ls-remote --heads origin ' + branchName) || '');
    var re = new RegExp('^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\\trefs/heads/' + escapeRegExp(branchName) + '$', 'm');
    return re.test(out);
}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).
"}

function escapeRegExp(s) {

function remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName) {

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).
"}

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: First-run branch setup in central mode (insteadOf-rewritten origin) dies because branch-existence probes read git stderr warnings as proof that the branch exists on the remote.

**Root cause**: `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical `js/common/pullRequest.js:8-16` + 17 byte-identical inline copies) filters only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started` / `Script done` / `COMMAND=` / `COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`). The dmtools JS bridge (`cli_execute_command`) hands scripts stdout+stderr merged (deliberate Java-parity contract, `redirectErrorStream(true)`), so git's `warning: redirecting to <url>/` (printed by git 2.54 on every network command against a redirecting GitLab server) survives cleaning. Every branch-existence probe that branches on capture `.trim()` emptiness then classifies a warning-only capture as "branch exists on remote". Failure chain (reported case): `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:259-260` probe → capture = `'warning: redirecting to …'` → deciding line `:265 if (remoteBranches.trim())` → `:270` fetch of the missing ref fails (caught) → `:275 git checkout -B <b> origin/<b>` → `fatal: 'origin/<b>' is not a commit` → `action()` rethrows → preCliJSAction dies before the CLI agent starts.

**Impact**: 14 vulnerable sites across 13 files (blast radius in ticket). 3 FATAL sites (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` dev+feature probes, `js/common/gitOps.js:_switchToBranch`) kill the dev/rework job before the agent starts on every per-ticket first run in central mode. 8 non-fatal sites proceed on the wrong/base branch or skip/mask pushes. 1 worst-case site (`postTestReworkResults.js:294-302`) extracts `remoteSha = capture.split(/\s+/)[0]` = `'warning:'` and reports a false "Push rejected" even on success. 6 sites using `indexOf('refs/heads/<b>')` are immune. Fires only when BOTH hold: branch genuinely absent (per-ticket first run) AND newer git prints the redirect warning. Attribution: image content delta (git binary 2.43→2.54), NOT dmtools version, NOT agents/js, NOT runner config — the latent warning-blind-probe defect is older than both images (≥ 2026-05-31).

**Fix approach** (defense in the probe, per ticket):
- (a) Primary — add `remoteBranchExists(runCommand, workingDir, branchName)` to `js/common/pullRequest.js` (next to `ensureRemoteBranchRef`): a branch exists on origin iff the cleaned `git ls-remote --heads origin <b>` capture contains a real ref line `^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$` (multiline). Migrate the 14 vulnerable sites (13 files) onto it. `postTestReworkResults.js` additionally parses the SHA from the matched ref line — never `split(/\s+/)[0]` of line 1.
- (b) Secondary — extend `cleanCommandOutput` to also drop line-anchored git noise (`^warning: `, `^note: `; anchored only — mid-line occurrences in diffs/logs must survive).

**Previous attempt**: none — first development pass on this bug (precedent gh-908/PR #909 is an unrelated fix).

Progress: AC1, AC1b, report tests now GREEN. But 5 failures:

1. `does not touch the feature branch step when the feature branch already exists` — the mock at :176 returns '9a7e2aec...\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'. The flow now: dev branch ai/PROJ-1 ls-remote → mock returns '' (not in responses → default '') → remoteBranchExists false → two-branch block → feature probe → '9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/...' → remoteBranchExists(feature) should be TRUE... why fail? Hmm — my regex: `'^([0-9a-f]{7,40})\\trefs/heads/' + escapeRegExp(branchName) + '\\r?$'` with 'm' flag. The capture after cleanCommandOutput... The response string is `'9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'` — 40 hex chars: 9a7e2aec × 5 = 40 ✓. Tab ✓. Hmm.

THAT's the breakage: my quoting change broke the exact-string mock keys.

KISS + repo convention: DON'T quote (branch names flow from configLoader.resolveBranchName / config — same trust as before; the helper is no worse than the sites it replaces). Drop the quotes.

blocks.text:
Progress: AC1, AC1b, report tests now GREEN. But 5 failures:

1. `does not touch the feature branch step when the feature branch already exists` — the mock at :176 returns '9a7e2aec...\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'. The flow now: dev branch ai/PROJ-1 ls-remote → mock returns '' (not in responses → default '') → remoteBranchExists false → two-branch block → feature probe → '9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/...' → remoteBranchExists(feature) should be TRUE... why fail? Hmm — my regex: `'^([0-9a-f]{7,40})\\trefs/heads/' + escapeRegExp(branchName) + '\\r?$'` with 'm' flag. The capture after cleanCommandOutput... The response string is `'9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'` — 40 hex chars: 9a7e2aec × 5 = 40 ✓. Tab ✓. Hmm.

Wait — maybe the issue is the ls-remote command CHANGED: I now quote the branch name: `git ls-remote --heads origin "release/rc_mobile_proj-1"` — the responses map keys are `git ls-remote --heads origin release/rc_mobile_proj-1` (unquoted) → no match → default '' → probe false!! THAT's the breakage: my quoting change broke the exact-string mock keys.

Decision: do I quote or not? The ticket's proposal used quoteBranch(branchName). Existing call sites DON'T quote. Mock keys across ~14 test files use unquoted. Quoting adds safety for exotic names but breaks the established call+mock shape everywhere. KISS + repo convention: DON'T quote (branch names flow from configLoader.resolveBranchName / config — same trust as before; the helper is no worse than the sites it replaces). Drop the quotes.

2-4. reportExistingDevBranch tests — same quoting issue (responses keyed unquoted).

5. AC3 — same quoting issue.

Fix pullRequest.js remoteBranchSha: remove quotes → 'git ls-remote --heads origin ' + branchName.

blocks.text:
Progress: AC1, AC1b, report tests now GREEN. But 5 failures:

1. `does not touch the feature branch step when the feature branch already exists` — the mock at :176 returns '9a7e2aec...\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'. The flow now: dev branch ai/PROJ-1 ls-remote → mock returns '' (not in responses → default '') → remoteBranchExists false → two-branch block → feature probe → '9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/...' → remoteBranchExists(feature) should be TRUE... why fail? Hmm — my regex: `'^([0-9a-f]{7,40})\\trefs/heads/' + escapeRegExp(branchName) + '\\r?$'` with 'm' flag. The capture after cleanCommandOutput... The response string is `'9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'` — 40 hex chars: 9a7e2aec × 5 = 40 ✓. Tab ✓. Hmm.

Wait — maybe the issue is the ls-remote command CHANGED: I now quote the branch name: `git ls-remote --heads origin "release/rc_mobile_proj-1"` — the responses map keys are `git ls-remote --heads origin release/rc_mobile_proj-1` (unquoted) → no match → default '' → probe false!! THAT's the breakage: my quoting change broke the exact-string mock keys.

Quoting adds safety for exotic names but breaks the established call+mock shape everywhere. KISS + repo convention: DON'T quote (branch names flow from configLoader.resolveBranchName / config — same trust as before; the helper is no worse than the sites it replaces). Drop the quotes.

2-4. reportExistingDevBranch tests — same quoting issue (responses keyed unquoted).

5. AC3 — same quoting issue.

Progress: AC1, AC1b, report tests now GREEN. But 5 failures:

1. `does not touch the feature branch step when the feature branch already exists` — the mock at :176 returns '9a7e2aec...\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'. The flow now: dev branch ai/PROJ-1 ls-remote → mock returns '' (not in responses → default '') → remoteBranchExists false → two-branch block → feature probe → '9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/...' → remoteBranchExists(feature) should be TRUE... why fail? Hmm — my regex: `'^([0-9a-f]{7,40})\\trefs/heads/' + escapeRegExp(branchName) + '\\r?$'` with 'm' flag. The capture after cleanCommandOutput... Progress: AC1, AC1b, report tests now GREEN. But 5 failures:

1. `does not touch the feature branch step when the feature branch already exists` — the mock at :176 returns '9a7e2aec...\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'. The flow now: dev branch ai/PROJ-1 ls-remote → mock returns '' (not in responses → default '') → remoteBranchExists false → two-branch block → feature probe → '9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/...' → remoteBranchExists(feature) should be TRUE... why fail? Hmm — my regex: `'^([0-9a-f]{7,40})\\trefs/heads/' + escapeRegExp(branchName) + '\\r?$'` with 'm' flag. The capture after cleanCommandOutput... The response string is `'9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'` — 40 hex chars: 9a7e2aec × 5 = 40 ✓. Tab ✓. Hmm.

Wait — maybe the issue is the ls-remote command CHANGED: I now quote the branch name: `git ls-remote --heads origin "release/rc_mobile_proj-1"` — the responses map keys are `git ls-remote --heads origin release/rc_mobile_proj-1` (unquoted) → no match → default '' → probe false!! THAT's the breakage: my quoting change broke the exact-string mock keys.

Decision: do I quote or not? The ticket's proposal used quoteBranch(branchName). Existing call sites DON'T quote. Mock keys across ~14 test files use unquoted. Quoting adds safety for exotic names but breaks the established call+mock shape everywhere. KISS + repo convention: DON'T quote (branch names flow from configLoader.resolveBranchName / config — same trust as before; the helper is no worse than the sites it replaces). Drop the quotes.

2-4. reportExistingDevBranch tests — same quoting issue (responses keyed unquoted).

5. AC3 — same quoting issue.

Fix pullRequest.js remoteBranchSha: remove quotes → 'git ls-remote --heads origin ' + branchName.

Hmm — my regex: `'^([0-9a-f]{7,40})\\trefs/heads/' + escapeRegExp(branchName) + '\\r?$'` with 'm' flag. The capture after cleanCommandOutput... The response string is `'9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'` — 40 hex chars: 9a7e2aec × 5 = 40 ✓. Tab ✓. Hmm.

THAT's the breakage: my quoting change broke the exact-string mock keys.

Quoting adds safety for exotic names but breaks the established call+mock shape everywhere. KISS + repo convention: DON'T quote (branch names flow from configLoader.resolveBranchName / config — same trust as before; the helper is no worse than the sites it replaces). Drop the quotes.

blocks.text:
Progress: AC1, AC1b, report tests now GREEN. But 5 failures:

1. `does not touch the feature branch step when the feature branch already exists` — the mock at :176 returns '9a7e2aec...\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'. The flow now: dev branch ai/PROJ-1 ls-remote → mock returns '' (not in responses → default '') → remoteBranchExists false → two-branch block → feature probe → '9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/...' → remoteBranchExists(feature) should be TRUE... why fail? Hmm — my regex: `'^([0-9a-f]{7,40})\\trefs/heads/' + escapeRegExp(branchName) + '\\r?$'` with 'm' flag. The capture after cleanCommandOutput... The response string is `'9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'` — 40 hex chars: 9a7e2aec × 5 = 40 ✓. Tab ✓. Hmm.

Wait — maybe the issue is the ls-remote command CHANGED: I now quote the branch name: `git ls-remote --heads origin "release/rc_mobile_proj-1"` — the responses map keys are `git ls-remote --heads origin release/rc_mobile_proj-1` (unquoted) → no match → default '' → probe false!! THAT's the breakage: my quoting change broke the exact-string mock keys.

Decision: do I quote or not? The ticket's proposal used quoteBranch(branchName). Existing call sites DON'T quote. Mock keys across ~14 test files use unquoted. Quoting adds safety for exotic names but breaks the established call+mock shape everywhere. KISS + repo convention: DON'T quote (branch names flow from configLoader.resolveBranchName / config — same trust as before; the helper is no worse than the sites it replaces). Drop the quotes.

2-4. reportExistingDevBranch tests — same quoting issue (responses keyed unquoted).

5. AC3 — same quoting issue.

Fix pullRequest.js remoteBranchSha: remove quotes → 'git ls-remote --heads origin ' + branchName.

blocks.text:
Progress: AC1, AC1b, report tests now GREEN. But 5 failures:

1. `does not touch the feature branch step when the feature branch already exists` — the mock at :176 returns '9a7e2aec...\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'. The flow now: dev branch ai/PROJ-1 ls-remote → mock returns '' (not in responses → default '') → remoteBranchExists false → two-branch block → feature probe → '9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/...' → remoteBranchExists(feature) should be TRUE... why fail? Hmm — my regex: `'^([0-9a-f]{7,40})\\trefs/heads/' + escapeRegExp(branchName) + '\\r?$'` with 'm' flag. The capture after cleanCommandOutput... The response string is `'9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec9a7e2aec\trefs/heads/release/rc_mobile_proj-1'` — 40 hex chars: 9a7e2aec × 5 = 40 ✓. Tab ✓. Hmm.

Wait — maybe the issue is the ls-remote command CHANGED: I now quote the branch name: `git ls-remote --heads origin "release/rc_mobile_proj-1"` — the responses map keys are `git ls-remote --heads origin release/rc_mobile_proj-1` (unquoted) → no match → default '' → probe false!! THAT's the breakage: my quoting change broke the exact-string mock keys.

Decision: do I quote or not? The ticket's proposal used quoteBranch(branchName). Existing call sites DON'T quote. Mock keys across ~14 test files use unquoted. Quoting adds safety for exotic names but breaks the established call+mock shape everywhere. KISS + repo convention: DON'T quote (branch names flow from configLoader.resolveBranchName / config — same trust as before; the helper is no worse than the sites it replaces). Drop the quotes.

2-4. reportExistingDevBranch tests — same quoting issue (responses keyed unquoted).

5. AC3 — same quoting issue.

Fix pullRequest.js remoteBranchSha: remove quotes → 'git ls-remote --heads origin ' + branchName.

Ah — my perl consolidation earlier **missed** several files! What happened: the perl regex `function cleanCommandOutput\(output\)\s*\{(?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*\}` requires the function body to have no nested-brace constructs deeper than one level — but bodies with `filter(function(line) { ... })` contain braces inside braces — `[^{}]*\}` matches ONE level. `function(line) { return ...; }` — that's `{...}` inside the outer `{...}` — should match `\{[^{}]*\}`... Ah — my perl consolidation earlier **missed** several files! What happened: the perl regex `function cleanCommandOutput\(output\)\s*\{(?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*\}` requires the function body to have no nested-brace constructs deeper than one level — but bodies with `filter(function(line) { ... })` contain braces inside braces — `[^{}]*\}` matches ONE level. `function(line) { return ...; }` — that's `{...}` inside the outer `{...}` — should match `\{[^{}]*\}`... The outer body: `\n    if (!output) return '';\n    return output.split('\\n').filter(function(line) {\n        return ...;\n    }).join('\\n').trim();\n` — the alternation `[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\}` repeated: `[^{}]` consumes until the inner `{`, then `\{[^{}]*\}` consumes the inner function's braces — OK that should work...

Ah — my perl consolidation earlier **missed** several files! What happened: the perl regex `function cleanCommandOutput\(output\)\s*\{(?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*\}` requires the function body to have no nested-brace constructs deeper than one level — but bodies with `filter(function(line) { ... })` contain braces inside braces — `[^{}]*\}` matches ONE level. `function(line) { return ...; }` — that's `{...}` inside the outer `{...}` — should match `\{[^{}]*\}`... The outer body: `\n    if (!output) return '';\n    return output.split('\\n').filter(function(line) {\n        return ...;\n    }).join('\\n').trim();\n` — the alternation `[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\}` repeated: `[^{}]` consumes until the inner `{`, then `\{[^{}]*\}` consumes the inner function's braces — OK that should work...

blocks.text:
Ah — my perl consolidation earlier **missed** several files! What happened: the perl regex `function cleanCommandOutput\(output\)\s*\{(?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*\}` requires the function body to have no nested-brace constructs deeper than one level — but bodies with `filter(function(line) { ... })` contain braces inside braces — `[^{}]*\}` matches ONE level. `function(line) { return ...; }` — that's `{...}` inside the outer `{...}` — should match `\{[^{}]*\}`... Ah — my perl consolidation earlier **missed** several files! What happened: the perl regex `function cleanCommandOutput\(output\)\s*\{(?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*\}` requires the function body to have no nested-brace constructs deeper than one level — but bodies with `filter(function(line) { ... })` contain braces inside braces — `[^{}]*\}` matches ONE level. `function(line) { return ...; }` — that's `{...}` inside the outer `{...}` — should match `\{[^{}]*\}`... The outer body: `\n    if (!output) return '';\n    return output.split('\\n').filter(function(line) {\n        return ...;\n    }).join('\\n').trim();\n` — the alternation `[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\}` repeated: `[^{}]` consumes until the inner `{`, then `\{[^{}]*\}` consumes the inner function's braces — OK that should work...

Ah — my perl consolidation earlier **missed** several files! What happened: the perl regex `function cleanCommandOutput\(output\)\s*\{(?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*\}` requires the function body to have no nested-brace constructs deeper than one level — but bodies with `filter(function(line) { ... })` contain braces inside braces — `[^{}]*\}` matches ONE level. `function(line) { return ...; }` — that's `{...}` inside the outer `{...}` — should match `\{[^{}]*\}`... blocks.text:
Ah — my perl consolidation earlier **missed** several files! What happened: the perl regex `function cleanCommandOutput\(output\)\s*\{(?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*\}` requires the function body to have no nested-brace constructs deeper than one level — but bodies with `filter(function(line) { ... })` contain braces inside braces — `[^{}]*\}` matches ONE level. `function(line) { return ...; }` — that's `{...}` inside the outer `{...}` — should match `\{[^{}]*\}`... The outer body: `\n    if (!output) return '';\n    return output.split('\\n').filter(function(line) {\n        return ...;\n    }).join('\\n').trim();\n` — the alternation `[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\}` repeated: `[^{}]` consumes until the inner `{`, then `\{[^{}]*\}` consumes the inner function's braces — OK that should work...

What happened: the perl regex `function cleanCommandOutput\(output\)\s*\{(?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*\}` requires the function body to have no nested-brace constructs deeper than one level — but bodies with `filter(function(line) { ... })` contain braces inside braces — `[^{}]*\}` matches ONE level. `function(line) { return ...; }` — that's `{...}` inside the outer `{...}` — should match `\{[^{}]*\}`... arguments.content:
gh-912 — ls-remote probes counted git stderr warnings as branch existence

### Root Cause
- `cleanCommandOutput` filtered only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started`/`done`, `COMMAND=`/`COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`); git stderr (`warning: redirecting to …`) survived, and the JS bridge hands probes stdout+stderr merged.
- Branch-existence probes branching on capture `.trim()` emptiness read a warning-only capture as "branch exists" → first-run setup fetched a missing ref, `checkout -B origin/<b>` died (`fatal: not a commit`) before the CLI agent started.
- Trigger is environmental (git ≥2.54 prints the insteadOf redirect warning; image apt layers refreshed between the green/red jobs), but the warning-blind probe defect is in this repo.

### Fix
- `js/common/pullRequest.js`: strict ref-line parsing — `remoteBranchSha`/`remoteBranchExists` (`^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$`, multiline) + `remoteRefLines`; branch exists iff a real ref line matches (E1 `{7,40}`, E2 escaping, E5 `refs/tags` rejected).
- `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical, now the single implementation — 20 inline copies consolidated onto it per gh-823) additionally drops line-anchored `^warning: `/`^note: ` lines, never mid-line (E4).
- Migrated the vulnerable probes in 13 files: FATAL (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` ×3 incl. `reportExistingDevBranch`, `gitOps._switchToBranch`), wrong-branch (`checkoutBranch.js` ×2, `preCliTest/Mobile/StoryTestAutomationSetup.js`, `developTicketAndCreatePR.js` glob) and inverse-masking (`post*TestAutomationResults.js`, `pushReworkChanges.js`, `storyTestAutomationRework.js`); `postTestReworkResults.js` push-verify now parses the SHA from the matched ref line (no more `remoteSha='warning:'`).
- The 6 immune `indexOf('refs/heads/…')` sites and all local-git emptiness checks untouched.

### Test Coverage
- Repro (RED first, 19 failing tests across 5 suites, now GREEN): warning-only capture through real `preCliDevelopmentSetup`/`gitOps`/`postTestReworkResults` sources takes the create-branch / not-found path and completes; ref-line-in-noise still "exists" both orders; SHA extraction from polluted capture; `remoteBranchExists` table (empty/warning-only/ref/warning+ref/6-hex garbage → false/false/true/true/false).
- Unrealistic ls-remote mocks corrected to `<40-hex>\trefs/heads/<b>`; suites stubbing the PR helper now load the real module.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` → **2825 passed / 0 failed** (2800 pre-existing + 25 new). Known pre-existing latent failures in `test_bugFixBatchDevelopment.js` (not in `run_all.json`) verified identical on a clean baseline worktree.

### Notes
- dmtools-dart stream-merge contract untouched (deliberate Java parity — non-goal); no runner/CI-config change; no retry logic.
- Scope addition beyond the ticket's 14-site table: `reportExistingDevBranch` probe in `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` (same file, same defect class — stderr noise produced a bogus "RESUMED leg" `existing_work.md`); test-loader updates required by the helper consolidation.

{"content":"gh-912 — ls-remote probes counted git stderr warnings as branch existence

### Root Cause
- `cleanCommandOutput` filtered only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started`/`done`, `COMMAND=`/`COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`); git stderr (`warning: redirecting to …`) survived, and the JS bridge hands probes stdout+stderr merged.
- Branch-existence probes branching on capture `.trim()` emptiness read a warning-only capture as "branch exists" → first-run setup fetched a missing ref, `checkout -B origin/<b>` died (`fatal: not a commit`) before the CLI agent started.
- Trigger is environmental (git ≥2.54 prints the insteadOf redirect warning; image apt layers refreshed between the green/red jobs), but the warning-blind probe defect is in this repo.

### Fix
- `js/common/pullRequest.js`: strict ref-line parsing — `remoteBranchSha`/`remoteBranchExists` (`^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$`, multiline) + `remoteRefLines`; branch exists iff a real ref line matches (E1 `{7,40}`, E2 escaping, E5 `refs/tags` rejected).
- `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical, now the single implementation — 20 inline copies consolidated onto it per gh-823) additionally drops line-anchored `^warning: `/`^note: ` lines, never mid-line (E4).
- Migrated the vulnerable probes in 13 files: FATAL (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` ×3 incl. `reportExistingDevBranch`, `gitOps._switchToBranch`), wrong-branch (`checkoutBranch.js` ×2, `preCliTest/Mobile/StoryTestAutomationSetup.js`, `developTicketAndCreatePR.js` glob) and inverse-masking (`post*TestAutomationResults.js`, `pushReworkChanges.js`, `storyTestAutomationRework.js`); `postTestReworkResults.js` push-verify now parses the SHA from the matched ref line (no more `remoteSha='warning:'`).
- The 6 immune `indexOf('refs/heads/…')` sites and all local-git emptiness checks untouched.

### Test Coverage
- Repro (RED first, 19 failing tests across 5 suites, now GREEN): warning-only capture through real `preCliDevelopmentSetup`/`gitOps`/`postTestReworkResults` sources takes the create-branch / not-found path and completes; ref-line-in-noise still "exists" both orders; SHA extraction from polluted capture; `remoteBranchExists` table (empty/warning-only/ref/warning+ref/6-hex garbage → false/false/true/true/false).
- Unrealistic ls-remote mocks corrected to `<40-hex>\trefs/heads/<b>`; suites stubbing the PR helper now load the real module.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` → **2825 passed / 0 failed** (2800 pre-existing + 25 new). Known pre-existing latent failures in `test_bugFixBatchDevelopment.js` (not in `run_all.json`) verified identical on a clean baseline worktree.

### Notes
- dmtools-dart stream-merge contract untouched (deliberate Java parity — non-goal); no runner/CI-config change; no retry logic.
- Scope addition beyond the ticket's 14-site table: `reportExistingDevBranch` probe in `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` (same file, same defect class — stderr noise produced a bogus "RESUMED leg" `existing_work.md`); test-loader updates required by the helper consolidation.
