{"content":"gh-912 — ls-remote probes counted git stderr warnings as branch existence

### Root Cause
- `cleanCommandOutput` filtered only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started`/`done`, `COMMAND=`/`COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`); git stderr (`warning: redirecting to …`) survived, and the JS bridge hands probes stdout+stderr merged.
- Branch-existence probes branching on capture `.trim()` emptiness read a warning-only capture as "branch exists" → first-run setup fetched a missing ref, `checkout -B origin/<b>` died (`fatal: not a commit`) before the CLI agent started.
- Trigger is environmental (git ≥2.54 prints the insteadOf redirect warning; image apt layers refreshed between the green/red jobs), but the warning-blind probe defect is in this repo.

### Fix
- `js/common/pullRequest.js`: strict ref-line parsing — `remoteBranchSha`/`remoteBranchExists` (`^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$`, multiline) + `remoteRefLines`; branch exists iff a real ref line matches (E1 `{7,40}`, E2 escaping, E5 `refs/tags` rejected).
- `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical, now the single implementation — 20 inline copies consolidated onto it per gh-823) additionally drops line-anchored `^warning: `/`^note: ` lines, never mid-line (E4).
- Migrated the vulnerable probes in 13 files: FATAL (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` ×3 incl. `reportExistingDevBranch`, `gitOps._switchToBranch`), wrong-branch (`checkoutBranch.js` ×2, `preCliTest/Mobile/StoryTestAutomationSetup.js`, `developTicketAndCreatePR.js` glob) and inverse-masking (`post*TestAutomationResults.js`, `pushReworkChanges.js`, `storyTestAutomationRework.js`); `postTestReworkResults.js` push-verify now parses the SHA from the matched ref line (no more `remoteSha='warning:'`).
- The 6 immune `indexOf('refs/heads/…')` sites and all local-git emptiness checks untouched.

### Test Coverage
- Repro (RED first, 19 failing tests across 5 suites, now GREEN): warning-only capture through real `preCliDevelopmentSetup`/`gitOps`/`postTestReworkResults` sources takes the create-branch / not-found path and completes; ref-line-in-noise still "exists" both orders; SHA extraction from polluted capture; `remoteBranchExists` table (empty/warning-only/ref/warning+ref/6-hex garbage → false/false/true/true/false).
- Unrealistic ls-remote mocks corrected to `<40-hex>\trefs/heads/<b>`; suites stubbing the PR helper now load the real module.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` → **2825 passed / 0 failed** (2800 pre-existing + 25 new). Known pre-existing latent failures in `test_bugFixBatchDevelopment.js` (not in `run_all.json`) verified identical on a clean baseline worktree.

### Notes
- dmtools-dart stream-merge contract untouched (deliberate Java parity — non-goal); no runner/CI-config change; no retry logic.
- Scope addition beyond the ticket's 14-site table: `reportExistingDevBranch` probe in `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` (same file, same defect class — stderr noise produced a bogus "RESUMED leg" `existing_work.md`); test-loader updates required by the helper consolidation.

{"content":"gh-912 — ls-remote probes counted git stderr warnings as branch existence

### Root Cause
- `cleanCommandOutput` filtered only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started`/`done`, `COMMAND=`/`COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`); git stderr (`warning: redirecting to …`) survived, and the JS bridge hands probes stdout+stderr merged.
- Branch-existence probes branching on capture `.trim()` emptiness read a warning-only capture as "branch exists" → first-run setup fetched a missing ref, `checkout -B origin/<b>` died (`fatal: not a commit`) before the CLI agent started.
- Trigger is environmental (git ≥2.54 prints the insteadOf redirect warning; image apt layers refreshed between the green/red jobs), but the warning-blind probe defect is in this repo.

### Fix
- `js/common/pullRequest.js`: strict ref-line parsing — `remoteBranchSha`/`remoteBranchExists` (`^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$`, multiline) + `remoteRefLines`; branch exists iff a real ref line matches (E1 `{7,40}`, E2 escaping, E5 `refs/tags` rejected).
- `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical, now the single implementation — 20 inline copies consolidated onto it per gh-823) additionally drops line-anchored `^warning: `/`^note: ` lines, never mid-line (E4).
- Migrated the vulnerable probes in 13 files: FATAL (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` ×3 incl. `reportExistingDevBranch`, `gitOps._switchToBranch`), wrong-branch (`checkoutBranch.js` ×2, `preCliTest/Mobile/StoryTestAutomationSetup.js`, `developTicketAndCreatePR.js` glob) and inverse-masking (`post*TestAutomationResults.js`, `pushReworkChanges.js`, `storyTestAutomationRework.js`); `postTestReworkResults.js` push-verify now parses the SHA from the matched ref line (no more `remoteSha='warning:'`).
- The 6 immune `indexOf('refs/heads/…')` sites and all local-git emptiness checks untouched.

### Root Cause
- `cleanCommandOutput` filtered only script-wrapper artifacts (`Script started`/`done`, `COMMAND=`/`COMMAND_EXIT_CODE=`); git stderr (`warning: redirecting to …`) survived, and the JS bridge hands probes stdout+stderr merged.
- Branch-existence probes branching on capture `.trim()` emptiness read a warning-only capture as "branch exists" → first-run setup fetched a missing ref, `checkout -B origin/<b>` died (`fatal: not a commit`) before the CLI agent started.
- Trigger is environmental (git ≥2.54 prints the insteadOf redirect warning; image apt layers refreshed between the green/red jobs), but the warning-blind probe defect is in this repo.

### Fix
- `js/common/pullRequest.js`: strict ref-line parsing — `remoteBranchSha`/`remoteBranchExists` (`^[0-9a-f]{7,40}\trefs/heads/<escaped-name>$`, multiline) + `remoteRefLines`; branch exists iff a real ref line matches (E1 `{7,40}`, E2 escaping, E5 `refs/tags` rejected).
- `cleanCommandOutput` (canonical, now the single implementation — 20 inline copies consolidated onto it per gh-823) additionally drops line-anchored `^warning: `/`^note: ` lines, never mid-line (E4).
- Migrated the vulnerable probes in 13 files: FATAL (`preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` ×3 incl. `reportExistingDevBranch`, `gitOps._switchToBranch`), wrong-branch (`checkoutBranch.js` ×2, `preCliTest/Mobile/StoryTestAutomationSetup.js`, `developTicketAndCreatePR.js` glob) and inverse-masking (`post*TestAutomationResults.js`, `pushReworkChanges.js`, `storyTestAutomationRework.js`); `postTestReworkResults.js` push-verify now parses the SHA from the matched ref line (no more `remoteSha='warning:'`).
- The 6 immune `indexOf('refs/heads/…')` sites and all local-git emptiness checks untouched.

### Test Coverage
- Repro (RED first, 19 failing tests across 5 suites, now GREEN): warning-only capture through real `preCliDevelopmentSetup`/`gitOps`/`postTestReworkResults` sources takes the create-branch / not-found path and completes; ref-line-in-noise still "exists" both orders; SHA extraction from polluted capture; `remoteBranchExists` table (empty/warning-only/ref/warning+ref/6-hex garbage → false/false/true/true/false).
- Unrealistic ls-remote mocks corrected to `<40-hex>\trefs/heads/<b>`; suites stubbing the PR helper now load the real module.
- Full suite: `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json` → **2825 passed / 0 failed** (2800 pre-existing + 25 new). Known pre-existing latent failures in `test_bugFixBatchDevelopment.js` (not in `run_all.json`) verified identical on a clean baseline worktree.

### Notes
- dmtools-dart stream-merge contract untouched (deliberate Java parity — non-goal); no runner/CI-config change; no retry logic.
- Scope addition beyond the ticket's 14-site table: `reportExistingDevBranch` probe in `preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` (same file, same defect class — stderr noise produced a bogus "RESUMED leg" `existing_work.md`); test-loader updates required by the helper consolidation.

- 6 immune `indexOf` sites untouched; mocks corrected to `<40-hex>\trefs/heads/<b>`; suites stubbing the PR helper now load the real module.
